[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## The Objective Mode Difference                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Unlike PRD mode (predefined tasks), Objective mode is **goal-driven**:    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - You don't know the solution upfront                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Each iteration is an experiment toward the goal                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - You must respect constraints at all times                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - You decide when to signal success, plateau, or impossibility            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Reading objective.json                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```json                                                                   [39m[49m

[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Plateau-Breaking Protocol                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **This protocol is MANDATORY when iterations show diminishing returns.**  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Phase 0: Plateau Detection (REQUIRED before forming hypothesis)       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Read `objective.json` and calculate stagnation indicators:                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. **Check metricHistory**: How many iterations since improvement >       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  `stopping.plateauThreshold.minImprovement`?                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. **Determine escalation level** based on stagnation duration:           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | Escalation Level | Trigger | Required Behavior |                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  |------------------|---------|-------------------|                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | EXPLORE | Normal state | Standard hypothesis formation |                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | PIVOT | 2+ iterations without significant improvement | Must try        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  different approach category |                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | REFRAME | 4+ iterations without significant improvement | Must          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  challenge assumptions or problem framing |                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. **Scan progress.txt** for recent approach categories (see below)       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Output your assessment:                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m

[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <iterations_since_significant_improvement>[N]</iterations_since_signifi   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  cant_improvement>                                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <escalation_level>[EXPLORE|PIVOT|REFRAME]</escalation_level>              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <recent_approach_categories>[List from last 3                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  iterations]</recent_approach_categories>                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </plateau_check>                                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Phase 1: Approach Categorization                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Every hypothesis belongs to one of these universal categories:            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | Category | Description | Examples |                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  |----------|-------------|----------|                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | PARAMETER_TUNING | Adjust thresholds, hyperparameters, config values |  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Change confidence threshold, batch size, timeout |                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | ALGORITHM_CHANGE | Swap one method for a different one | Replace regex  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  with ML, switch sorting algorithm |                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | DATA_PIPELINE | Change how input is processed, filtered, augmented |    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Add preprocessing, change data format, filter inputs |                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | ARCHITECTURE | Structural changes to system design | Add caching layer, [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  split into stages, parallelize |                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | ERROR_ANALYSIS | Deep-dive into failure cases to find root causes |     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Analyze worst predictions, categorize error types |                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE | Question whether the problem is framed correctly [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  | Is the metric right? Is ground truth accurate? |                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **When in PIVOT or REFRAME escalation:**                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - You MUST select an approach category NOT used in the last 2 iterations  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - If all categories have been tried recently, use ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Phase 2: Meta-Learning from History                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Before forming your hypothesis, extract patterns from progress.txt:       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <history_analysis>                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <successful_patterns>                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  [What types of changes improved metrics? List with iteration numbers]     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </successful_patterns>                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <failed_patterns>                                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  [What types of changes had no effect? List with iteration numbers]        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </failed_patterns>                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <untried_approaches>                                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  [Which approach categories have NOT been attempted?]                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </untried_approaches>                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </history_analysis>                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Use this analysis to:**                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Repeat patterns similar to successful changes                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Avoid patterns similar to failed changes                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Prioritize untried approaches when in PIVOT/REFRAME                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Phase 3: Escalation-Dependent Hypothesis Formation                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **If EXPLORE (normal state):**                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Form hypothesis targeting the observed weakness. Standard process.        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **If PIVOT (2+ iterations stalled):**                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. List 3 assumptions the current approach makes                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. Select ONE assumption to deliberately challenge                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. Design an approach that works IF that assumption is wrong              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <assumption_challenge>                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <assumptions>                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. [Assumption the current approach makes]                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. [Another assumption]                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. [Third assumption]                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </assumptions>                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <challenging>[Which assumption you're testing]</challenging>              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <alternative_approach>[How to proceed if assumption is                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  false]</alternative_approach>                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </assumption_challenge>                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **If REFRAME (4+ iterations stalled):**                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Before ANY implementation, answer these questions:                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. **Is the metric aligned with the actual goal?** Could a different      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  metric be better?                                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. **Is the ground truth reliable?** Sample and verify edge cases         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. **What's the theoretical ceiling?** Is there a fundamental limit to    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  this approach?                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  4. **Should we signal PLATEAU?** Is it time to stop and recommend         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  alternatives?                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <reframe_analysis>                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <metric_alignment>[Is the metric measuring what we actually               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  want?]</metric_alignment>                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <ground_truth_quality>[Any evidence of ground truth                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  issues?]</ground_truth_quality>                                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <theoretical_ceiling>[What's the best this approach can                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  achieve?]</theoretical_ceiling>                                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <recommendation>[Continue with specific approach | Signal                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  PLATEAU]</recommendation>                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </reframe_analysis>                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Phase 4: Hypothesis Self-Critique                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Before implementing, validate your hypothesis:                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <hypothesis_check>                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <approach_category>[PARAMETER_TUNING|ALGORITHM_CHANGE|DATA_PIPELINE|ARC   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  HITECTURE|ERROR_ANALYSIS|ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE]</approach_category>        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <similar_to_recent>[YES/NO - check progress.txt for similar               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  attempts]</similar_to_recent>                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <expected_impact>[X% improvement - if <1% in PIVOT+,                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  reconsider]</expected_impact>                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <what_if_wrong>[What will we learn even if this fails?]</what_if_wrong>   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <addresses_largest_gap>[Does this target the biggest source of            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  errors?]</addresses_largest_gap>                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </hypothesis_check>                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Proceed only if:**                                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `similar_to_recent=NO` (or you have strong reason to retry)             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `expected_impact >= 1%` (or high information value)                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - In PIVOT+: using different approach category than recent iterations     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Forming Hypotheses                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  After completing the Plateau-Breaking Protocol, articulate your           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  hypothesis:                                                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. **Observation**: What does the current state tell you?                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. **Hypothesis**: What change do you predict will improve the metric?    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. **Approach Category**: Which of the 6 categories does this belong to?  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  4. **Rationale**: Why do you believe this? (Based on history analysis,    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  domain knowledge, or patterns)                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  5. **Expected outcome**: What metric improvement do you expect?           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  6. **Constraint check**: Does this approach violate any constraints?      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Document your hypothesis in progress.txt BEFORE implementing.             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Respecting Constraints                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Constraints in `objective.constraints` are **non-negotiable**. Before     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  each change:                                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. Read all constraints                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. Verify your proposed change won't violate any                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. If uncertain, implement a smaller change and measure                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **If a constraint would be violated**, do NOT proceed. Instead, note in   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  progress.txt why the approach was abandoned and try an alternative.       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Output Formats                                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Metrics Block (REQUIRED after each iteration)                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  After running the verification command, output your metrics in ONE of     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  these formats:                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **JSON format (preferred):**                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <metrics>                                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  {"accuracy": 0.85, "precision": 0.82, "recall": 0.88,                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  "inference_time_ms": 145}                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </metrics>                                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Key-value format (alternative):**                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <metrics>                                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  accuracy=0.85                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  precision=0.82                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  recall=0.88                                                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  inference_time_ms=145                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </metrics>                                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  The metrics MUST include all values from `verification.metricsToTrack`.   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Termination Signals                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  When you determine the objective loop should end, output the appropriate  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  signal:                                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **SUCCESS** - Objective achieved:                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <objective>SUCCESS</objective>                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Output when the `successCriteria` expression evaluates to true (e.g.,     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  accuracy >= 0.90).                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **IMPOSSIBLE** - Objective cannot be achieved:                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <objective>IMPOSSIBLE</objective>                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <reason>Clear explanation of why the objective cannot be                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  achieved</reason>                                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <category>technical|scope|resource</category>                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Categories:                                                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `technical`: Fundamental technical limitation (e.g., "The model         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  architecture cannot support this accuracy level without exceeding size    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  constraints")                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `scope`: Objective is outside achievable scope (e.g., "The validation   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  dataset has labeling errors that cap accuracy at 87%")                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `resource`: Resource constraints prevent achievement (e.g., "Would      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  require GPU compute not available in this environment")                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **PLATEAU** - No more improvement possible:                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <objective>PLATEAU</objective>                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <attempts>                                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration 5: Tried data augmentation → +1.2% accuracy                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration 6: Tried learning rate scheduling → +0.3% accuracy            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration 7: Tried dropout tuning → no improvement                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration 8: Tried batch normalization → no improvement                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </attempts>                                                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <suggestion>Consider: collecting more training data, or accepting 87% as  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  the achievable ceiling</suggestion>                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Output when you've exhausted reasonable approaches and see diminishing    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  returns.                                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **MAX_ITERATIONS** - Budget exhausted:                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <objective>MAX_ITERATIONS</objective>                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Output when iteration count reaches `stopping.maxIterations` without      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  success.                                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Progress Report Format                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  APPEND to progress.txt (never replace, always append):                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## [Date/Time] - Objective Iteration [N]                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Approach Category**: [PARAMETER_TUNING|ALGORITHM_CHANGE|DATA_PIPELINE|A [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  RCHITECTURE|ERROR_ANALYSIS|ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE]                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Escalation Level**: [EXPLORE|PIVOT|REFRAME]                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Hypothesis: [What you predicted would happen]                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Changes: [What you implemented]                                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Files modified                                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Approach taken                                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Result: [Metric before] → [Metric after] ([+/-change])                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Evaluation: [Did hypothesis hold? What did you learn?]                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Pattern for future iterations:**                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [If successful: What pattern should be repeated?]                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [If failed: What anti-pattern should be avoided?]                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Next direction: [What to try next iteration, or termination signal]       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ---                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Important for meta-learning:**                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Always include the Approach Category - this enables category rotation   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Document patterns/anti-patterns - future iterations will extract these  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Be specific about WHY something worked or failed                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Iteration Strategy                                                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Adaptive Strategy Based on Escalation Level                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Rather than fixed phases, adapt your strategy based on the                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Plateau-Breaking Protocol:                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **EXPLORE Level (making progress):**                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Continue with approaches that show improvement                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Build on successful patterns from history_analysis                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Focus on the largest remaining error category                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Incremental refinement is acceptable                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **PIVOT Level (2+ iterations stalled):**                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - STOP incremental refinement - it's not working                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Switch to a different approach category                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Challenge one assumption the current approach makes                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Prioritize high-information-value experiments (learn even if fail)      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **REFRAME Level (4+ iterations stalled):**                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Question the problem framing before any implementation                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Audit ground truth quality on edge cases                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Consider whether a fundamentally different approach is needed           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Signal PLATEAU if you've exhausted reasonable approaches                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ### Approach Category Rotation                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Track which categories have been tried in progress.txt. When stuck:       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. Count attempts per category from recent iterations                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. Select the category with fewest recent attempts                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. If all categories tried, combine two underexplored categories (hybrid  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  approach)                                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Anti-patterns to avoid when stuck:**                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "Improve X by adding small tweak" → This is PARAMETER_TUNING again      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "Make X more robust/conservative" → Still same approach, different      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  threshold                                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "Handle edge case Y" → ERROR_ANALYSIS is valid, but ensure it's not     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  just patching                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Patterns that break plateaus:**                                         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "Replace X approach entirely with Y" → ALGORITHM_CHANGE                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "The data suggests assumption Z is wrong" → ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - "Combine unused category A with category B" → Hybrid approach           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Constraint Violation Recovery                                          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  If you accidentally violate a constraint:                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. **Stop immediately** - don't commit                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. **Revert changes** - `git checkout .`                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. **Document** - Note in progress.txt what happened and why              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  4. **Adjust approach** - Find a constraint-respecting alternative         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  A constraint violation is worse than a failed experiment. Failed          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  experiments teach; violations invalidate the entire approach.             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## When to Signal IMPOSSIBLE                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Signal IMPOSSIBLE when you have **concrete evidence** that the objective  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  cannot be achieved, not just when it's hard. Evidence includes:           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Mathematical proof (e.g., "This architecture has a theoretical max of   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  X")                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Empirical ceiling (e.g., "5 different approaches all hit 87% and no     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  higher")                                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Fundamental conflict (e.g., "Achieving Y requires violating constraint  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Z")                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Do NOT signal IMPOSSIBLE** just because:                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - The current approach failed                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - You're running low on ideas                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Progress is slower than expected                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  When uncertain, default to PLATEAU over IMPOSSIBLE.                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## When to Signal PLATEAU                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Prerequisites before signaling PLATEAU:**                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. You've reached REFRAME escalation level (4+ iterations without         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  significant improvement)                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. You've completed the reframe_analysis and found no promising path      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  forward                                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. You've tried at least 3 different approach categories (not just        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  variations of one)                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  4. You can articulate what was attempted and why each approach hit a      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ceiling                                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **Checklist before PLATEAU signal:**                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [ ] Tried ALGORITHM_CHANGE (not just PARAMETER_TUNING)?                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [ ] Tried ASSUMPTION_CHALLENGE (questioned the framing)?                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [ ] Tried ERROR_ANALYSIS (understood where errors come from)?           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - [ ] Identified a theoretical ceiling or fundamental limitation?         [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  If you cannot check all boxes, you may not have exhausted the search      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  space.                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  **PLATEAU signal format:**                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```xml                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <objective>PLATEAU</objective>                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <attempts>                                                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration N (CATEGORY): [What was tried] → [Result]                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Iteration M (CATEGORY): [What was tried] → [Result]                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ...                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </attempts>                                                               [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <ceiling_analysis>                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  [What is the theoretical or practical ceiling and why?]                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </ceiling_analysis>                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  <suggestion>                                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  [What might help: more data, different tools, human review, accepting     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  current level]                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  </suggestion>                                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Include a meaningful `<attempts>` summary showing approach category       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  diversity and a `<suggestion>` for what might help (even if outside       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  current scope).                                                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Quality Requirements                                                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - ALL commits must not break the project (tests should pass)              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Constraint violations are NOT acceptable                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Document every experiment, even failures                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Keep changes small and reversible                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Commit Message Format                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  For objective mode, use the `exp:` prefix:                                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  exp: [Hypothesis summary] - [Result: +X.X% / no change / -X.X%]           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ```                                                                       [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  Examples:                                                                 [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `exp: Add data augmentation - +2.3% accuracy`                           [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `exp: Increase model depth - no change (constraint hit)`                [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - `exp: Tune learning rate - -0.5% accuracy (reverted)`                   [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Before Committing                                                      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  1. **Constraint check**: Does the change violate any objective            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  constraints?                                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  2. **Metrics captured**: Did you run verification and output `<metrics>`  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  block?                                                                    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  3. **Hypothesis documented**: Is your reasoning in progress.txt?          [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  ## Important                                                              [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Each iteration is ONE experiment                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - **Run Plateau-Breaking Protocol FIRST** - check escalation level before [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  forming hypothesis                                                        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Commit even negative results (learning is progress)                     [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Read progress.txt thoroughly - extract patterns and anti-patterns,      [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  don't repeat failed approaches                                            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - **Track Approach Categories** - include in progress.txt for category    [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  rotation                                                                  [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Constraints are sacred - never violate them                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - **In PIVOT/REFRAME: switch categories, challenge assumptions** -        [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  incremental tweaks won't help                                             [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m  - Signal termination when appropriate - don't waste iterations            [39m[49m    
[48;2;55;55;55m[38;2;255;255;255m                                                                            [39m[49m
